time_window_policy: Time32/48/64 retain at least 6 observations, at most 64; strict retains at least 2. Count12 isolates count from time. All use the existing polynomial model and selection.
kalman_policy: CA state driven by continuous white jerk, q=20R/tau^5, R=1; actual dt; initialize velocity from first two observations with corresponding covariance. Forecast anchored at latest actual position.
selection: 检查逐类别、运动族、采样率、噪声与时距的误差及预测覆盖率，不能只看总体 RMS。
独立报告真实下一采样点、插值参考与合成解析真值。
真实绘图使用配对重采样评估差异，不把一幅图内的观测当作独立样本。
先检查共同数值和状态契约，不能靠异常、超预算或大量弃权改善得分。
开发集筛选后，仅对基线及入选方案做验证集确认；保留集封存。
若没有充分的多指标优势，保留现有默认方案，不强行选冠军。

rounds.reason: CA32 and strict time windows improved average errors but regressed on clean curves. Test continuous-time jerk states and neighboring strict windows before opening validation.

continuous_model_definition: N=3 or 4 states; F_ij=dt^(j-i)/(j-i)! for j>=i; Q_ij=q*dt^(2N-1-i-j)/((N-1-i)!(N-1-j)!(2N-1-i-j)); q=((N-1)!)^2*(2N-1)/tau^(2N-1). R=1. Initial position/velocity covariance from two observations; higher derivative prior from Q(tau).
numerical_boundary_fix: A shared budget-rounding failure near world origin was reproduced in the production baseline and experimental adapters. Both now reproject the realized displacement before final bound verification. All candidates are rerun under the same corrected policy.
